title: Making a phone call in English: phrases, conversation, speaking | English Routine
description:
Making a phone call — مكالمة تليفون
A full lesson for everyday American English, with Arabic help: 8 words and phrases, a real conversation, 3 listening questions, then your turn to speak.
درس كامل: ٨ كلمات بمعناها بالعربي، الحوار، ٣ أسئلة، وبعدين دورك تتكلم بصوتك.

Chapters
0:00 8 words
0:45 The conversation
1:22 3 questions
1:46 Your turn: speak

Words
• this is… = معاك… (في التليفون)
• hold on = استنى لحظة / ثانية
• call back = يرجع يتصل
• you're breaking up = صوتك بيقطع
• leave a message = يسيب رسالة
• put you through = أحوّلك (للشخص)
• speak up = يعلّي صوته
• missed call = مكالمة فايتة

Practice this situation in the app (it plays the other person and shows you what to fix), one of 665 real-life situations, A1 to C2:
